name: Netarhat
description: Netarhat is a cool hill plateau famous for spectacular sunrises, pine forests and tranquil viewpoints. Great for photography, short hikes and homestays.

name: Hundru Falls
description: Hundru Falls plunges from a rocky hill into the Subarnarekha river and is popular for monsoon views and picnic outings.

name: Betla National Park
description: Betla National Park includes sal forests, meadows and wildlife such as deer, elephants and many birds. Safari drives are available.

name: Parasnath Hill
description: Parasnath is the highest mountain in Jharkhand and an important Jain pilgrimage site with ancient temples and panoramic treks.

name: Baidyanath Dham (Deoghar)
description: Baidyanath Dham attracts pilgrims year-round, and the town comes alive during the Shravani Mela.

name: Palamu Forts
description: Palamu Fort features ramparts and gateways and offers rugged landscape and historic viewpoints.

name: Jonha Falls (Shiv Ganga)
description: Jonha Falls offers a scenic cascade and a cool pool area, popular for photography and picnics.

name: Hazaribagh National Park
description: Hazaribagh NP features dry deciduous forests and wildlife like deer and many birds — good for walks and birdwatching.

name: Jagannath Temple, Ranchi
description: Jagannath Temple is modeled after Puri’s architecture and hosts frequent festivals and community events.

name: Ranchi Lake (Harina Lake)
description: Ranchi Lake offers boating and evening promenades — a local family spot with easy access to eateries.

name: Tagore Hill
description: Tagore Hill was a retreat for Rabindranath Tagore and offers viewpoints and garden spaces.

name: Betla Palace & Museum
description: Betla Palace reflects historical architecture and hosts a small museum showcasing regional artifacts.

name: Dassam Falls
description: Dassam Falls is near Ranchi with interesting rock formations; enjoyable during and after rains.

name: Kanke Dam
description: Kanke Dam has pathways and boating; a convenient spot for morning walks and family picnics.

name: Porahat Ruins
description: Porahat features ruins that reflect regional history and is an offbeat destination for heritage lovers.

name: Sita Falls
description: Sita Falls is quieter and ideal for offbeat travelers wanting to explore natural waterfalls.

name: Rajrappa Temple
description: Rajrappa offers a spiritual atmosphere and scenic river views alongside temple rituals.

name: Gonda Dam & Park
description: Gonda Dam Park has lawns, boating options and is family-friendly near Hazaribagh town.

name: Gomoh Railway Heritage
description: Gomoh is tied to India’s railway and coal history and is interesting for industrial heritage enthusiasts.

name: Ranchi Rock Garden
description: Ranchi Rock Garden has landscaped rock formations and sculptures — a pleasant urban park for families.

name: Dhurwa Zoological Park
description: Dhurwa Zoo is a local educational zoo with animal exhibits and conservation messages for visitors.

name: Harmu Lake & Park
description: Harmu Lake is an urban retreat for strolling, exercise and evenings near Ranchi’s central areas.

name: Khunti Tribal Villages
description: Khunti and nearby villages showcase tribal culture, traditional crafts and community tourism experiences.

name: Tata Steel Zoological Park
description: Tata Steel Zoo is well-kept, informative and a good family spot for seeing different species.

name: Hanging Bridge, Deoghar
description: The Hanging Bridge is a rustic, photogenic structure with scenic views and local legends.

name: Jonha (Baidyanath nearby)
description: Jonha is near Deoghar and offers local culture and quiet temple visits; good as a calm stopover for pilgrims.

name: Tusu & Chhau festival spots
description: Experience traditional Chhau dance performances and harvest festivals (Tusu) across rural Jharkhand.

name: Palamu Wildlife Zone
description: Palamu offers a wide region of forests and wildlife sanctuaries with diverse fauna and birdlife.

name: Palamu waterfalls & rock views
description: A region in Palamu with several small waterfalls and rocky vantage points ideal for short treks.

name: Ranchi city heritage walk
description: A walk through central Ranchi reveals colonial buildings, temples and modern civic spaces worth exploring.
